angle.hook: Professor Layton returns on Dec 10 and PS5 and Steam pre-orders opened with a free 11-track soundtrack
angle.why_now: LEVEL-5 opened pre-orders at midnight JST on 12 Nov and the price is now official
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf players on PS5 and PC can pre-order now; Switch pre-orders come later; the game has no Arabic language option on Steam
angle.payoff: pre-order by 9 Dec for the bonus soundtrack; USD 64.99
